name: black-friday-deals-2026 (Shashankt255)
accepts: Deals 'for developers, designers, cybersecurity professionals, gamers, and tech enthusiasts' in 12 categories, among them Developer Tools & SaaS, Design & Productivity, AI & ML Tools and Wellness Apps. No Mac or iOS section; apps sit in the category that fits.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding a row to the right category table in README.md, title like 'Add: ProductName BF2026 deal'; an issue is the alternative. CONTRIBUTING.md says pull requests are reviewed within 24 hours during November.
entry_format: | [Name](official deal url) | Short description | **XX% OFF** (code, dates) | ✅ |  (columns Product, Description, Deal, Status; ✅ confirmed, ⏳ expected)
rules: Real discounts only, with the official deal page linked; no affiliate links; one deal per row; one-line descriptions; no expired deals.
No ordering rule; the tables are not alphabetical.
The README asks for a star 'to help it trend' and offers a badge. Both are requests, not conditions.
Pull requests that hit a merge conflict are closed and the deal is added by the owner's own commit ('Merged manually'); a closed pull request there is not a rejection until its comment says so.
The season's README is archived as README_2026.md at the end of the season.
status_note: Created 10 Nov 2026, 375 deals by 20 Nov. 23 pull requests from outside authors merged, the latest on 19 Nov 2026; 10 open; 19 closed without a merge, the recent ones with 'merged manually' comments.
recommended_for: software and SaaS for developers, designers and tech enthusiasts; apps in Design & Productivity or Wellness Apps
